description: Statically analyze a directory of JavaScript/TypeScript/Electron source: module list, import/export graph, and Electron process-boundary detection (ipcMain/ipcRenderer/contextBridge, require("electron"), nodeIntegration flags). Every finding carries evidence (file + line range), AIDefence-screened before return. Use when you need a structural map of unfamiliar JS/Electron source rather than reading files one at a time — native Read is fine for a single already-identified file, but wrong for discovering the import graph or Electron boundaries across a whole app. Does not accept a .asar path directly — run rure_extract_asar first and pass its unpackedPath.

path.description: Absolute path to a directory of extracted JS/Electron source

name: rure_analyze_js_app
